title: Job definition contract with name, handler, inputSchema, retryPolicy and timeoutMs
asA: developer authoring a job in an applying project
iWant: one shipped job-definition shape { name, handler, inputSchema, retryPolicy, timeoutMs } that the jobs runtime registers at boot on the applied queue consumer
soThat: every job in the project follows one uniform contract without the blueprint prescribing an input-validation library or a handler-callback style

acceptanceCriteria.description: The two toy job-definition modules under packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/infra-s3-and-queue/jobs/ (send-welcome-email.mjs and refresh-cache.mjs) each export a plain object with name (string), handler (async function), inputSchema (opaque, non-null), retryPolicy ({ maxAttempts: positive integer, backoff: one of exponential | constant | linear }), and timeoutMs (positive integer). The jobs runtime under src/jobs-runtime.mjs registers every job by name at boot and dispatches by message.name.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the shared sample-app fixture with the T-4 jobs-runtime wired on top of the T-3 in-memory queue seam
acceptanceCriteria.when: the fixture jobs runtime boots and reads the jobs/ directory
acceptanceCriteria.then: both toy job modules load without throwing; the runtime's registry has entries keyed by name whose values carry handler, inputSchema, retryPolicy and timeoutMs; dispatch by message.name calls the matching handler
